Richer context is what makes personal agents personal. Today, they see your email, calendar, and accounts, and miss everything happening in front of you. NewEyes AI from @CollovLabs is built as a personal agent with eyes. Camera glasses see what you see, and open-ear earphones answer in your ear. The more of your day an agent can see, the more it can tailor its help to you. Muse gave your agent a computer. Instinct gave it your phone number. We gave it eyes.
